data_fields.name: once_complexity
data_fields.donor_constant: once adds 1 to a when-header's complexity

data_fields.name: expression_complexity
data_fields.donor_constant: expression adds its boolean-operator count plus 1 (count itself not read)

best_idea: Let a conversation hold its place (program counter and pending options) in a small VM that parks at each line, command and menu until the client answers, and pick among conditional variants by least-viewed-then-most-specific with a random tie-break, both reading and writing one variable store.
decision_why: The parked-script VM and the least-viewed variant pick give quest-stage and NPC dialogue variety and waiting without any tick cost, but the donor has no quest model and its commands are unvalidated text, so the store must be the server ledger and rewards must be server-validated grants.
acceptance: A server test runs a three-option NPC node with one disabled option: choose() rejects the disabled option, two passing variants are not picked twice in a row, and a reward command changes the ledger only through the server grant function.
